result.summary: Found 2 issues: a broken/missing image in the Popular right now section and a horizontal overflow causing content to be cut off.

issues.description: The first restaurant card in the 'Popular right now' section displays a placeholder/broken image icon instead of an actual restaurant image
issues.suggestion: Load and display the actual restaurant image, or if image is unavailable, show a fallback UI that doesn't display a broken placeholder icon

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' section has horizontal overflow - the third restaurant card (Trattoria Piccol) is partially cut off on the right side
issues.suggestion: Adjust the card width or container overflow properties to ensure all three visible cards fit properly within the viewport without being cut off
